podcast.body: Released on September 12, 1985, this single performed much better than "Rock Hard" and was featured on the soundtrack of the film "Krush Groove." Around this time, band members adopted their well-known stage names: Adam Yauch as MCA, Adam Horowitz as Ad Rock, and Mike Diamond as Mike D. "She's on it, originally from the soundtrack of a film called Crush Groove."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
